mapper.insert: insert into elder (consumer_id, name, relation, age, phone, address, blood_type, allergy_history, avatar) values (#{consumerId}, #{name}, #{relation}, #{age}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{bloodType}, #{allergyHistory}, #{avatar})

insert into order (elder_id, service_type, service_description, start_time, end_time, is_volunteer_payment, volunteer_payment_amount, volunteer_payment_status, volunteer_payment_time, payment_proof, service_fee, advanced_payment_amount, payment_type, status, create_time, consumer_id) values (#{elderId}, #{serviceType}, #{serviceDescription}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{isVolunteerPayment}, #{volunteerPaymentAmount}, #{volunteerPaymentStatus}, #{volunteerPaymentTime}, #{paymentProof}, #{serviceFee}, #{advancedPaymentAmount}, #{paymentType}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{consumerId})
